summary.text: Draft Assembly resolution (in Russian) on intensifying research into tropical parasitic diseases. It urges Member States to expand national research and asks the Director-General to strengthen WHO research on diseases such as malaria, onchocerciasis and schistosomiasis and to report back.

sections.title: Page 4

summary.text: Draft Assembly resolution (in Russian) on psychosocial factors and health, stating that WHO should begin programmes on how these factors affect general and mental health and health services. It asks the Director-General to set up multidisciplinary programmes and report to the Executive Board and Assembly.

summary.text: Draft Assembly resolution (in Russian) on BCG vaccine quality control, urging Member States that import or produce the vaccine to use the WHO international quality control system.

summary.text: Draft Assembly resolution (in Russian) on the adequacy of health statistics, asking that the next revision of the International Classification of Diseases meet new data needs while keeping its traditional uses.
